REQ-PERC-0.text: Phase-1 perception deliverables (cv-harness TC-001…TC-016) complete and honest

REQ-HOST-1.text: Reproducible host setup with pinned, recorded versions and an automated drift check

REQ-HOST-2.text: Isolation between ROS (system py3.10), perception (conda crackvision py3.11) and local inference, verified automatically

REQ-HOST-3.text: Device access (RealSense, arm adapter) granted by reviewed least-privilege actions

REQ-LLM-1.text: Local coding model chosen from current primary sources + a project benchmark (quantization, context, tool reliability, latency, license, VRAM coexistence) with bounded downloads

REQ-LLM-2.text: Local model served by a pinned runtime; only benchmark-qualified task classes are routed to it

REQ-CAM-1.text: D405 discovery with actionable diagnostics (USB 3, firmware, permissions)

REQ-CAM-2.text: Aligned colour/depth capture with timestamps, intrinsics, depth scale, extrinsics and metadata

REQ-CAM-3.text: Lossless recording and deterministic replay usable without the camera

REQ-PERC-1.text: Existing OpenCrack zero-shot segmentation + visualization preserved (OpenCrack is not replaced)

REQ-PERC-2.text: 1-px skeleton, branch handling and ordered crack paths in the original pixel frame

REQ-PERC-3.text: Evaluation on representative real D405 imagery

REQ-GEOM-1.text: Correct depth projection with invalid-depth handling and per-point uncertainty

REQ-GEOM-2.text: Camera-to-robot calibration with explicit transform conventions and residuals

REQ-GEOM-3.text: TCP calibration and physical boresight verification

REQ-MOT-1.text: MoveIt integration with the real B601-DM model: limits, controllers, collision scene

REQ-MOT-2.text: Reachability, Cartesian paths along cracks, time parameterization within vel/acc limits

REQ-INT-1.text: Simulation and recorded-data integration tests of the full pipeline

REQ-INT-2.text: Separately gated hardware commissioning with verified limits, collision checks, e-stop, controlled conditions and operator-sourced evidence

REQ-OPS-1.text: Operator workflow: clean launch → capture → plan → preview → controlled execution, with failure recovery

REQ-OPS-2.text: Reproducible install/config/tests/evaluation results, handoff docs, requirements→evidence map, honest readiness report

REQ-IL-1.text: Imitation learning only after the baseline is measured and reliable, and only if confirmed in capstone scope
